decided: Amends the triage decision after review round 1: the split is 3 adopted + 21 answered + 2 implements links (docs-accuracy -> review-lens-documentation, tests-required -> review-lens-tests), not the original 3 + 23. comment-hygiene's implements link was dropped as an overclaim (a bead-id regex does not enforce the comments-explain-WHY lens) and that row is answered instead; tests-required's applies_to widened to adapters/** and test/** so its implements claim is true repo-wide.
why: Review confirmed eight findings: two implements overclaims, two factually wrong answers (go vet does not check discarded errors — errcheck does; the tree signs with HMAC-SHA256, so 'no cryptographic surface' was false), an absent named mechanism in a rule body, two regex coverage gaps (CommandContext, assignment-form InsecureSkipVerify), and this drift itself between the first shard's 23 and the delivered 20.
cost_if_wrong: Same reversibility as the original: answers are records, links are one line, widened applies_to only adds review surface.
alternatives: Adopt review-lens-comments as a claude rule — rejected again: cost unmeasured per review, no judged local finding in the WHY class
scope: Supersedes the 23-answer count in the first triage shard; final state: .warden/catalog-answers.yaml holds 21 answers, three adopted rules carry widened Go-adapted patterns, tests-required applies repo-wide over logic-bearing paths.
